# current-ui/

## Summary

The File Tree page as the owner uses it now: `file-tree-explorer.html`, the page itself, and `file-tree.data.json`, the one data file it loads. It is published on claude.ai at a fixed link; the project IDE agent rebuilds the data, checks the page on a desktop and a phone width and publishes it again after every round that changes the tree, a doc or a How it works file.

nodes.name: file-tree-explorer.html
nodes.summary: the page: tree, tabs, edits, notes, questions
nodes.purpose: the page itself: the tree with search and filters, and for every file and folder its tabs (How it works, File, Example, Questions, and extra tabs such as jobs, links, tests or key names). The owner can edit a file or its How it works, leave notes and messages and ask questions; all of that waits in the page's own store until the next sync (ide-sync [10.1.2.6]).

details.label: Voice button (owner, D-060)
details.text: on the owner's server, the request box and the delete note box have a microphone button: press to record, press again to stop (at most 5 minutes, with a timer); the server turns the recording into text [53.3.5] and the page adds it to the box to check and send. On claude.ai the button is hidden, because a claude.ai page gets no microphone and cannot reach Groq.

details.label: Index files in the tree (owner, 2026-10-05 14:03)
details.text: every file and folder shows its `.index.md` as its own row (a file's right under it, a folder's first inside it); clicking it opens the item's How it works, which is that file. A `☑ metadata` switch above the tree hides or shows them, together with the Details files (`.meta.json`) since D-057; the filter finds them by name ("README.index").

details.label: On its own File tab (owner, 2026-10-05 14:21)
details.text: the page shows its own source, the same file that is published. `enrich.py` [10.1.2.5.2.3] reads it from `explorer/` when it builds the data, so the finished page goes there first. A long file shows 3,000 lines at a time with a button for more, and its size.

details.label: Apply changes (owner, 2026-10-06, D-046)
details.text: a button at the top of the page, with the number of items marked changed, carries every change waiting on the page into the files and shows the new tree. On claude.ai it posts one comment on the page and sends it to Claude (the page's `comments` capability); the Claude watching the page runs ide-sync [10.1.2.6] and ide-build [10.1.2.5], publishes the new tree, answers the comment and resolves it. The request is also saved in the page's store as an input of kind `apply`; when that input turns processed, the open page loads the new tree or asks the owner to reload. When no Claude is watching, the page keeps the request and asks the owner to say "sync the file tree" in the project chat. On the server [53.3] it starts one Claude Code run with the same request in the top folder's chat.

details.label: Proposed
details.text: a routine that checks the page's store on a schedule and runs ide-sync [10.1.2.6] when something is waiting, so the owner need not press Apply changes.

details.label: On the server (D-042, D-043)
details.text: when the page finds the server's service [53.3] next to it, it saves straight into the files and sends requests to Claude Code instead of using the page's store; it is no longer view only there.

details.label: Delete (owner, 2026-10-05 15:45, D-044)
details.text: every file and folder except the top has a Delete button next to its name. It opens a short form: what goes (a folder with how many items inside), an optional note for Claude about what to keep in mind, and "Delete and clean up". On the server the page sends it to Claude Code at once [53.3.3]; on claude.ai it is marked deleted and cleaned up at the next sync (ide-sync [10.1.2.6], "Deleting an item"). The deleted item stays in the tree, struck through, until the sync, with "Restore it" (claude.ai) or "Bring it back" (server, again through Claude Code). The deletion and the note are filed as an input.

details.label: One status: changed (owner, 2026-10-05 15:45, D-044)
details.text: the page shows no statuses for now (no dots, no legend, no exists, decided, proposed, name pattern or example agent). A "changed" tag marks whatever a request from the page touched: an edit, a note, an added or deleted item, a request in the box, and on the server every file Claude Code changed for a request. The marks stay until the next sync, and the Changed tab lists them. More statuses may come later. The tree notes keep decided and proposed for the agents.

details.label: Published at
details.text: https://claude.ai/artifact/72v2Uppt6jpfXLCjKNX9xs.

details.label: Draft
details.text: `/mnt/project-files/vision/explorer/file-tree-explorer.html`.

open_questions: served by any web server next to [53.1.2], it shows the same page, view only: saving and asking Claude come from claude.ai, so the header says "view only" and a message sent there says it reaches no one. Opening the file straight from disk does not load the data. The claude.ai link changes only when the files are published to it again.

folders start closed except the top levels, so a file deep inside (such as the system's `vision.md` or the vision skill) shows only once its folders are open; the search opens the folders on the way to each match. A first click on a closed folder now opens it as well as selecting it; a click on the selected folder, or on its arrow, closes it again.

<title>Agent OS File Tree</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Condensed:wght@500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Literata:ital,opsz,wght@0,7..72,400;0,7..72,600;1,7..72,400;1,7..72,600&family=Inter:ital,opsz,wght@0,14..32,400;0,14..32,600;1,14..32,400;1,14..32,600&family=Atkinson+Hyperlegible+Next:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400;1,600&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: tree | object sheet with tabs, and a chat dock pinned under the sheet. One pane at a time on phones. */
:root {
  --bg: #f3f4f1;
  --panel: #fbfbf9;
  --sunk: #e9ebe6;
  --line: #d6d9d2;
  --fg: #1c211e;
  --muted: #5d665f;
  --accent: #1d5a86;
  --accent-soft: #dde8f1;
  --code-bg: #eef0eb;
  --ok: #2f7a4b;      --ok-soft: #dcefe2;
  --warn: #9a6400;    --warn-soft: #f6ead0;
  --info: #1d5a86;    --info-soft: #dde8f1;
  --ph: #6b4f96;      --ph-soft: #ebe4f5;
  --exists: #0e7490;  --exists-soft: #d3edf1;
  --neutral: #6c736d; --neutral-soft: #e6e8e3;
  --danger: #a8352b;  --danger-soft: #f6dedb;
  --f-display: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "Arial Narrow", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --f-body: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --f-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
  --bg: #141816; --panel: #1a1f1c; --sunk: #202622; --line: #2e3531; --fg: #e3e7e3; --muted: #97a19a;
  --accent: #7fb6de; --accent-soft: #1f3344; --code-bg: #111512;
  --ok: #7cc795; --ok-soft: #1e3526; --warn: #e2b25a; --warn-soft: #3a2f17; --info: #7fb6de; --info-soft: #1f3344;
  --ph: #b9a2df; --ph-soft: #2e2640; --neutral: #9aa39c; --neutral-soft: #262c28; --danger: #ef8a80; --danger-soft: #3d2320; --exists: #6cc8d8; --exists-soft: #16323a; color-scheme: dark } }
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #141816; --panel: #1a1f1c; --sunk: #202622; --line: #2e3531; --fg: #e3e7e3; --muted: #97a19a;
  --accent: #7fb6de; --accent-soft: #1f3344; --code-bg: #111512;
  --ok: #7cc795; --ok-soft: #1e3526; --warn: #e2b25a; --warn-soft: #3a2f17; --info: #7fb6de; --info-soft: #1f3344;
  --ph: #b9a2df; --ph-soft: #2e2640; --neutral: #9aa39c; --neutral-soft: #262c28; --danger: #ef8a80; --danger-soft: #3d2320; --exists: #6cc8d8; --exists-soft: #16323a; color-scheme: dark }

html, body { height: 100%; }
body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); font: 14px/1.55 var(--f-body); }
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
button, input, textarea, select { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
code, .mono { font-family: var(--f-mono); font-size: 0.88em; }
code { background: var(--code-bg); padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 3px; }

.app { height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
header.bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px 16px; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); }
.brand { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.brand h1 { font: 600 19px/1.1 var(--f-display); margin: 0; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
.brand .ver { font: 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); }
.search { flex: 1 1 220px; max-width: 380px; position: relative; margin-left: auto; }
.search input { width: 100%; padding: 6px 10px 6px 30px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg); }
.search svg { position: absolute; left: 9px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--muted); }
.btn { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; white-space: nowrap; }
.btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.btn.primary { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--panel); font-weight: 500; }
.applybtn .n { font: 11px var(--f-mono); margin-left: 7px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--accent); }
.applybox { flex: 1 1 100%; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 10px; background: var(--accent-soft); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; }
.applybox p { margin: 0; flex: 1 1 300px; min-width: 0; }
.applybox.wait { background: var(--warn-soft); }
.btn.danger { color: var(--danger); }
.btn.quiet { background: transparent; border-color: transparent; color: var(--accent); padding-inline: 4px; }
.btn:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }

.panes { flex: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(270px, 380px) 1fr; min-height: 0; }
.treeside { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); }
.sidetabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 0 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); flex: none; }
.sidetabs .tab .n { font: 11px var(--f-mono); margin-left: 5px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--sunk); }
.sidetabs .tab[aria-selected="true"] .n { background: var(--accent-soft); }
.treeinfo { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); flex: none; }
.treeinfo[hidden] { display: none; }
.tree { overflow: auto; padding: 8px 0 40px; flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; }
.row.ctx .nm { color: var(--muted); }
.row.removed .nm { text-decoration: line-through; color: var(--danger); }
.row mark { background: var(--warn-soft); color: inherit; border-radius: 2px; padding: 0 1px; }
.chg { font: 600 9.5px var(--f-body); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; flex: none; background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); }
.detail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.dscroll { flex: 1 1 auto; overflow: auto; min-height: 0; }

/* tree */
.row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 12px 2px 0; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; min-height: 26px; position: relative; }
.row:hover { background: var(--sunk); }
.row[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--accent-soft); }
.row[aria-selected="true"] .nm { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
.row.idx .nm { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.row.idx .ic { opacity: .7; }
.row.idx.on { background: var(--sunk); }
.row.idx.on .nm { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
.sidetabs .idxtog { margin-left: auto; font: 11px var(--f-mono); }
.sidetabs .idxtog[aria-pressed="false"] { color: var(--muted); }
.row .tw { width: 16px; flex: none; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }
.row .ic { flex: none; width: 15px; color: var(--muted); display: flex; }
.row .nm { font: 13px var(--f-mono); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; min-width: 0; }
.row .num { margin-left: auto; font: 11px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); padding-left: 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.guide { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); }
.tree .empty { padding: 16px; color: var(--muted); }

.s-decided { --c: var(--ok); --cs: var(--ok-soft); }
.s-exists { --c: var(--exists); --cs: var(--exists-soft); }
.s-proposed { --c: var(--warn); --cs: var(--warn-soft); }
.s-planned { --c: var(--neutral); --cs: var(--neutral-soft); }
.s-placeholder { --c: var(--ph); --cs: var(--ph-soft); }
.s-example { --c: var(--info); --cs: var(--info-soft); }
.s-changed { --c: var(--warn); --cs: var(--warn-soft); }
.dot { background: var(--c); }
.chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 12px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--cs, var(--sunk)); color: var(--c, var(--fg)); border: 0; white-space: nowrap; }
button.chip { cursor: pointer; }
.chip .dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; }

/* sheet */
.head { padding: 18px 24px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-width: 980px; }
.crumbs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px 4px; font: 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); }
.crumbs button { border: 0; background: none; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted); font: inherit; }
.crumbs button:hover { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: underline; }
.titleline { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px 12px; }
.titleline h2 { font: 600 26px/1.15 var(--f-display); margin: 0; word-break: break-word; }
.titleline .nb { font: 500 15px var(--f-mono); color: var(--accent); }
.meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.lede { margin: 0; max-width: 72ch; color: var(--fg); font-size: 15px; }
.backbtn { display: none; align-self: flex-start; }

.tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 0 24px; margin-top: 14px; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; position: sticky; top: 0; background: var(--bg); z-index: 2; }
.tab { border: 0; background: none; padding: 9px 12px 8px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; }
.tab:hover { color: var(--fg); }
.tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--accent); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500; }
.tab .n { font: 11px var(--f-mono); margin-left: 4px; }
.tab.custom { color: var(--ph); }
.tab.custom[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ph); border-bottom-color: var(--ph); }
.panel { padding: 18px 24px 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px; max-width: 980px; }

section.blk { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
section.blk > h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 12px var(--f-body); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
section.blk > h3 .count { font: 11px var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: 0; }
.prose { max-width: 72ch; margin: 0; }
.prose p { margin: 0 0 8px; }
ul.list { margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; max-width: 76ch; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
.kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(120px, 170px) 1fr; gap: 8px 14px; max-width: 84ch; }
.kv dt { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; }
.kv dd { margin: 0; min-width: 0; }
.kv dd p { margin: 0 0 4px; }
.children { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(230px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }
.child { text-align: left; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 10px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
.child:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.child .cn { font: 13px var(--f-mono); display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; min-width: 0; }
.child .cn .t { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.child .cs { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); overflow: hidden; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; }

.codebox { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--code-bg); }
.codebox .cap { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--sunk); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.codebox pre { margin: 0; padding: 12px 14px; overflow: auto; max-height: 70vh; font: 12.5px/1.55 var(--f-mono); white-space: pre; }
.codebox .note { padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.emptyfile { border: 1px dashed var(--line); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
.emptyfile .cap { padding: 6px 12px; font: 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--line); background: var(--sunk); }
.emptyfile .body { padding: 26px 16px; display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start; color: var(--muted); }
.emptyfile .ln { font: 12.5px var(--f-mono); opacity: .6; }

.fieldtbl-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }
table.tbl { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 13px; }
table.tbl th { text-align: left; font: 600 11.5px var(--f-body); letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); background: var(--sunk); padding: 7px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); white-space: nowrap; }
table.tbl td { padding: 7px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); vertical-align: top; }
table.tbl tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
table.tbl td.k { font: 12.5px var(--f-mono); color: var(--accent); white-space: nowrap; }
table.tbl td.v { font: 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); }
table.tbl td.ex { font: 12px var(--f-mono); max-width: 240px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
table.tbl td.v { min-width: 120px; max-width: 220px; }
table.tbl td.k { max-width: 280px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: normal; }
table.tbl td:last-child { min-width: 220px; }
table.edit td { padding: 3px 4px; }
table.edit textarea, table.edit select { width: 100%; min-width: 130px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; padding: 5px 6px; border-radius: 4px; resize: none; field-sizing: content; min-height: 30px; line-height: 1.4; display: block; overflow: hidden; }
table.edit td:first-child textarea { min-width: 230px; font: 12.5px/1.4 var(--f-mono); }
table.edit textarea:hover, table.edit select:hover { border-color: var(--line); }
table.edit textarea:focus, table.edit select:focus { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--bg); }
table.edit td.b { text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; width: 1%; }
table.edit td.del { width: 1%; }
table.edit tr.dirty td { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn-soft) 55%, transparent); }
.tbl-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }

.ref { border: 0; background: none; padding: 0; font: 500 0.92em var(--f-mono); color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; }
.ref:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.ref.dec { color: var(--ok); }
.decs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
details.dec { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel); }
details.dec summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 6px 10px; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; list-style: none; }
details.dec summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
details.dec summary .id { font: 600 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--ok); flex: none; }
details.dec summary .tx { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; min-width: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
details.dec[open] summary .tx { white-space: normal; color: var(--fg); }
.concepts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.concept-text { background: var(--sunk); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; max-width: 72ch; font-size: 13.5px; }
.features { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.feat { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(130px, 190px) 1fr; gap: 10px; font-size: 13.5px; }
.feat .area { font-weight: 600; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.inherited { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
.inherited summary { cursor: pointer; }
.history { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.klist { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 84ch; }
details.kentry { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel); }
details.kentry > summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 7px 10px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 10px; align-items: center; list-style: none; }
details.kentry > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
details.kentry > summary .kh { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; flex: 1 1 220px; min-width: 0; }
details.kentry > summary .kdoc { font: 11.5px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); }
details.kentry .kbody { padding: 2px 12px 10px; font-size: 13.5px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.kbody p { margin: 0; max-width: 76ch; }
.kbody h4.mdh { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 13px; }
.kbody pre.mdpre { margin: 0; padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--sunk); border-radius: 6px; overflow: auto; max-height: 360px; font: 12px/1.5 var(--f-mono); white-space: pre; }
.kbody .applies { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; align-items: center; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.kbody .applies .fchip { font-size: 11.5px; padding: 1px 8px; }
.keep { margin-top: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; }
.keep .keep-h { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--muted); }
.keep .list { margin: 6px 0 0; }
.pending-in { border-left: 3px solid var(--warn); padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 13px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.pending-in .when { font: 11px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); }
.hitem { border-left: 3px solid var(--ok); padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 13px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.hitem.undone { border-color: var(--line); opacity: .7; }
.hitem .when { font: 11px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); }
.qa { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.qa .q { font-weight: 600; }
.qa .item { border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); padding: 2px 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.qa .item .when { font: 11px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); }
.openq { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.openq .item { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--panel); }
.openq .item span { min-width: 0; }
.plain { font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.65; max-width: 66ch; }
.plain p { margin: 0 0 12px; }
.note-muted { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.warnbox { background: var(--warn-soft); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 13px; }
.titleline .delbtn { margin-left: auto; align-self: center; }
.delbox { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-width: 680px; border: 1px solid var(--danger); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--danger-soft); font-size: 13px; }
.delbox p { margin: 0; }
.delbox label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.delbox textarea { width: 100%; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg); line-height: 1.45; font-family: var(--f-body); font-size: 13.5px; }
.btn.danger-fill { background: var(--danger); border-color: var(--danger); color: var(--panel); font-weight: 500; }
.btn.danger-fill:disabled, .btn.primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }

/* file tab: viewer with line comments, editor */
.filebar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 10px; align-items: center; padding: 6px 10px; background: var(--sunk); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.filebar .grow { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.filebar .src { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.msg .steps { margin: 6px 0 2px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.msg .steps summary { cursor: pointer; }
.msg .steps ol { margin: 4px 0 0; padding-left: 20px; font-family: var(--f-mono); font-size: 11.5px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.msg .askbox { margin: 8px 0; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--code-bg); }
.msg .askbox p { margin: 0 0 8px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.lmore { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: var(--f-body); }
.codeview { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px; background: var(--code-bg); font: 12.5px/1.6 var(--f-mono); overflow: auto; max-height: 72vh; padding: 6px 0; }
.lrow { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; }
.lrow:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 45%, transparent); }
.lnum { flex: none; width: 52px; text-align: right; padding: 0 12px 0 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; opacity: .65; }
.lnum:hover, .lnum:focus-visible { color: var(--accent); opacity: 1; }
.lnum:hover::before { content: "+ "; }
.lrow.has-c .lnum { color: var(--warn); font-weight: 600; opacity: 1; }
.ltxt { white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; min-width: 0; padding-right: 14px; }
.lcmts { padding: 6px 14px 8px 52px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--f-body); }
.cmt { border-left: 3px solid var(--warn); background: var(--panel); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 13px; max-width: 680px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.cmt.resolved { border-color: var(--line); opacity: .7; }
.cmt-h { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.cmt-b p { margin: 0 0 4px; } .cmt-b p:last-child { margin: 0; }
.cmt-a { display: flex; gap: 2px; }
.cmt-a .btn { font-size: 12px; padding: 1px 6px; }
.cform { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 680px; }
.cform textarea, .addform input, .addform select, .addform textarea { width: 100%; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg); line-height: 1.45; font-family: var(--f-body); font-size: 13.5px; }
.cform .acts, .editacts { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.editor { display: flex; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px; background: var(--code-bg); height: 62vh; min-height: 260px; overflow: hidden; }
.editor .gutter { margin: 0; padding: 10px 10px 10px 0; width: 52px; text-align: right; color: var(--muted); font: 12.5px/1.6 var(--f-mono); overflow: hidden; user-select: none; flex: none; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); white-space: pre; }
.editor textarea { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 10px 12px; font: 12.5px/1.6 var(--f-mono); resize: none; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; word-break: normal; overflow-x: hidden; overflow-y: auto; outline: none; tab-size: 2; }
#fe-mirror { position: absolute; visibility: hidden; left: -9999px; top: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; word-break: normal; padding: 0; border: 0; tab-size: 2; }
.howsec { display: grid; gap: 18px; max-width: 72ch; }
.howsec h4 { margin: 0 0 5px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--muted); }
.howsec p { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; }
.howsec ul.list, .howsec ol.list { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; }
.outline { max-width: 76ch; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 18px 12px; background: var(--panel); }
.outline h4.mdh { margin: 16px 0 4px; font-size: 15px; }
.outline h4.mdh:first-child { font-size: 17px; margin-top: 12px; }
.outline p { margin: 0; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted); }

/* Reader: a Markdown file read as a page of a book (owner, 2026-10-05). It has its own paper, white or black,
   chosen in the reader and remembered per viewer. A clean sans for the text by default (the serif was hard to read);
   the reader picks the face (Sans, Legible, Serif) and the size (S, M, L) from the Aa menu. */
.reader {
  --rd-bg: #ffffff; --rd-fg: #1c201e; --rd-head: #0d110f; --rd-muted: #5c645e; --rd-faint: #8a928b;
  --rd-accent: #1d5a86; --rd-accent-soft: #e2ecf4; --rd-rule: #e2e5e0; --rd-code-bg: #f4f6f2; --rd-code-fg: #1f2b25; --rd-th: #f8f9f7;
  --f-read: "Inter", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --rd-fs: 17px; --rd-lh: 1.7; --rd-ls: -0.003em;
  background: var(--rd-bg); color: var(--rd-fg); color-scheme: light;
  border: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; min-width: 0;
}
.reader.rd-dark {
  --rd-bg: #0b0d0c; --rd-fg: #d5dbd6; --rd-head: #f3f6f3; --rd-muted: #929b94; --rd-faint: #6b746d;
  --rd-accent: #8fc3e8; --rd-accent-soft: #15283a; --rd-rule: #222826; --rd-code-bg: #131715; --rd-code-fg: #cbd5cd; --rd-th: #101311;
  color-scheme: dark;
}
.reader.rf-legible { --f-read: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", Verdana, Tahoma, sans-serif; --rd-lh: 1.68; --rd-ls: 0; }
.reader.rf-serif { --f-read: "Literata", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif; --rd-lh: 1.72; --rd-ls: 0; }
.reader.rs-s { --rd-fs: 15.5px; }
.reader.rs-l { --rd-fs: 19.5px; }
.reader ::selection { background: var(--rd-accent-soft); color: var(--rd-head); }
/* editing in the Read view: double-click a block, edit its Markdown in place (owner, 2026-10-09) */
.reader.rd-editable .rd-doc [data-l] { border-radius: 6px; transition: box-shadow .12s; }
.reader.rd-editable .rd-doc [data-l]:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--rd-accent-soft); cursor: text; }
.rd-blockedit { margin: 1em -8px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--rd-accent); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--rd-bg); display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.rd-blockedit textarea { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 4.5em; resize: vertical; border: 0; outline: 0; background: var(--rd-code-bg); color: var(--rd-code-fg); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 14px/1.6 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.rd-blockedit .acts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font: 13px/1.4 var(--f-body, sans-serif); color: var(--rd-muted); }
.rd-blockedit button { font: 600 13px/1 var(--f-body, sans-serif); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); background: var(--rd-th); color: var(--rd-head); cursor: pointer; }
.rd-blockedit button.go { background: var(--rd-accent); border-color: var(--rd-accent); color: var(--rd-bg); }
.rd-blockedit button:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }
.rd-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
.filebar.solo { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }
.seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; padding: 2px; gap: 2px; background: var(--panel); }
.seg button { border: 0; background: none; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500; }

.rd-top { position: relative; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 12px; padding: 9px 14px 9px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); font: 12.5px/1.3 var(--f-body); color: var(--rd-muted); background: var(--rd-bg); }
.rd-top .grow { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.rd-name { font: 600 14px var(--f-display); color: var(--rd-head); letter-spacing: .01em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.rd-stat { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rd-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px; gap: 2px; }
.rd-seg button, .rd-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--rd-muted); padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; font: 12.5px var(--f-body); }
.rd-seg button:hover, .rd-btn:hover { color: var(--rd-head); }
.rd-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--rd-accent-soft); color: var(--rd-head); font-weight: 500; }
.rd-btn { border: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); }
.rd-top svg { flex: none; }
.reader :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--rd-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

.rd-body { padding: clamp(26px, 5vw, 60px) clamp(18px, 5vw, 64px) clamp(36px, 6vw, 76px); }
.rd-doc { max-width: 68ch; margin: 0 auto; font: 400 var(--rd-fs)/var(--rd-lh) var(--f-read); letter-spacing: var(--rd-ls); font-optical-sizing: auto; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; font-kerning: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
@media (min-width: 900px) { .rd-doc { font-size: calc(var(--rd-fs) + 1px); } }
.rd-aa { position: relative; }
.rd-aa > summary { list-style: none; }
.rd-aa > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.rd-aa-ic { font: 600 13px/1 var(--f-display); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.rd-aa[open] > summary { color: var(--rd-head); background: var(--rd-accent-soft); }
.rd-aa-pop { position: absolute; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 8px); z-index: 5; display: grid; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; min-width: 240px;
  background: var(--rd-bg); border: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }
.rd-aa-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.rd-aa-row > span { font: 600 11px var(--f-body); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--rd-faint); }
.rd-aa-row .rd-seg button { padding: 4px 10px; }
.rd-aa-row [data-rfont="sans"] { font-family: "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }
.rd-aa-row [data-rfont="legible"] { font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", Verdana, sans-serif; }
.rd-aa-row [data-rfont="serif"] { font-family: "Literata", Georgia, serif; }
.howfile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; min-width: 0; }
.howfile .filebar.solo { border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; border-bottom: 0; }
.howbody { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px; padding: 16px 18px; min-width: 0; }
.howbody .keep { margin-top: 16px; }
.rd-doc > :first-child { margin-top: 0; }
.rd-doc > :last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.rd-doc h1, .rd-doc h2, .rd-doc h3, .rd-doc h4 { color: var(--rd-head); text-wrap: balance; scroll-margin-top: 64px; }
.rd-doc h1 { font: 600 clamp(31px, 4.6vw, 44px)/1.06 var(--f-display); letter-spacing: -0.012em; margin: 0 0 .75em; }
.rd-doc h2 { font: 600 clamp(22px, 2.5vw, 27px)/1.2 var(--f-display); letter-spacing: -0.003em; margin: 2.2em 0 .6em; }
.rd-doc h3 { font: 600 1.08em/1.35 var(--f-body); margin: 1.8em 0 .45em; }
.rd-doc h4 { font: 600 12.5px/1.4 var(--f-body); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; color: var(--rd-muted); margin: 1.8em 0 .5em; }
.rd-doc h1 + h2 { margin-top: .8em; }
.rd-doc p { margin: 0 0 1.05em; hanging-punctuation: first; }
.rd-doc strong { font-weight: 600; color: var(--rd-head); }
.rd-doc em { font-style: italic; }
.rd-doc a { color: var(--rd-accent); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.rd-doc .rd-xref { border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--rd-faint); }
.rd-doc ul, .rd-doc ol { margin: 0 0 1.15em; padding-left: 1.35em; }
.rd-doc li { margin: .32em 0; padding-left: .25em; }
.rd-doc ul > li::marker { color: var(--rd-accent); }
.rd-doc ol > li::marker { color: var(--rd-muted); font: 600 .82em var(--f-body); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rd-doc li > ul, .rd-doc li > ol { margin: .35em 0 .2em; }
.rd-doc li > p { margin: 0 0 .5em; }
.rd-doc blockquote { margin: 1.5em 0; padding: .15em 0 .15em 1.15em; border-left: 3px solid var(--rd-accent); color: var(--rd-muted); }
.rd-doc blockquote p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.rd-doc hr { border: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--rd-rule); margin: 2.6em 0; }
.rd-doc code { font: .82em var(--f-mono); background: var(--rd-code-bg); color: var(--rd-code-fg); padding: .12em .38em; border-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.rd-doc .rd-num { font: .82em var(--f-mono); color: var(--rd-faint); }

.rd-code { margin: 1.4em 0 1.6em; border: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--rd-code-bg); min-width: 0; }
.rd-code .cap { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 6px 4px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); font: 11.5px var(--f-mono); color: var(--rd-faint); }
.rd-code pre { margin: 0; padding: 14px 16px 15px; overflow-x: auto; font: 13px/1.62 var(--f-mono); color: var(--rd-code-fg); tab-size: 2; }
.rd-code pre code { background: none; padding: 0; font-size: inherit; color: inherit; overflow-wrap: normal; }
.rd-copy { border: 0; background: none; color: var(--rd-muted); font: 11.5px var(--f-body); padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; }
.rd-copy:hover { color: var(--rd-head); background: var(--rd-bg); }

.rd-tbl { margin: 1.4em 0 1.7em; overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); border-radius: 9px; }
.rd-tbl table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font: 14.5px/1.5 var(--f-body); color: var(--rd-fg); }
.rd-tbl th { text-align: left; font: 600 11.5px/1.3 var(--f-body); letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--rd-muted); background: var(--rd-th); padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); white-space: nowrap; }
.rd-tbl td { padding: 10px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); vertical-align: top; min-width: 9ch; }
.rd-tbl tbody tr:first-child td { border-top: 0; }
.rd-tbl td code { font-size: .86em; }
.rd-tbl .r { text-align: right; } .rd-tbl .c { text-align: center; }

.rd-front { display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr; gap: 6px 16px; margin: 0 0 2.2em; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--rd-th); font: 13.5px/1.5 var(--f-body); }
.rd-front dt { font: 500 12px/1.6 var(--f-mono); color: var(--rd-faint); }
.rd-front dd { margin: 0; min-width: 0; color: var(--rd-fg); }

.rd-toc { max-width: 68ch; margin: 0 auto 2.4em; border: 1px solid var(--rd-rule); border-radius: 9px; font: 14px/1.4 var(--f-body); }
.rd-toc summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 10px 14px; color: var(--rd-head); font-weight: 500; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; }
.rd-toc summary span { color: var(--rd-faint); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 400; }
.rd-toc ol { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 4px 8px 10px; columns: 2 16rem; column-gap: 18px; }
.rd-toc li { break-inside: avoid; }
.rd-toc button, .rd-side button { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--rd-muted); font: inherit; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 5px; }
.rd-toc button:hover, .rd-side button:hover { color: var(--rd-head); }
.rd-toc li.l3 button, .rd-side li.l3 button { padding-left: 20px; font-size: .92em; }
.rd-toc code, .rd-side code { font: .9em var(--f-mono); background: none; padding: 0; }

/* full screen */
.rd-full { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 60; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: 0; border-radius: 0; }
.rd-full .rd-top { padding-top: calc(9px + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)); padding-left: calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)); padding-right: calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)); }

  const c = window.claude;

/* ---------- on the owner's server (apps/project-IDE/server/): the store is files in the repository, the box talks to Claude Code ---------- */
async function connectServer() {
  let h = null;

Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line." : "Claude Code is not set up on this server yet, so the box only saves your message. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.";

}
function serverDb() {
  const subs = {}, last = {};
  const api = (method, path, body) => fetch("api/store/" + path, { method, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body) })
    .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : r.json().then(e => { throw { code: (e && e.error) || "HTTP " + r.status }; }, () => { throw { code: "HTTP " + r.status }; }));

    const key = JSON.stringify(r.docs); if (last[name] === key) return; last[name] = key;   // like onSnapshot: only when something changed

    add: o => api("POST", name, o).then(r => { refresh(name); return { id: r.id }; }),

}
async function serverAsk(id, n, c, text, inputId, answerInput, extra) {

  setBusy(id); APPLY_RUN = isApply; renderApply(); hint("Claude Code is working in the repository. You can look at other items meanwhile; the answer stays here."); renderChat();
  const done = () => { m.live = false; RUN = null; setBusy(null); hint(DEFAULT_HINT); saveChat(id); if (selected === id) renderChatKeep(); };
  if (!SERVER.agent) { m.text = "Claude Code is not set up on this server yet, so your message is only saved. " + (SERVER.agent_error || ""); return done(); }
  let r = null;
  try { r = await fetch("api/agent", { method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ text, node_id: id, path: n.path, name: n.name, num: n.num || null, session: c.session || null, input_id: inputId, ...(extra || {}) }) }).then(x => x.json()); }
  catch (e) { m.text = "Could not reach the server (" + (e.message || e) + ")."; return done(); }
  if (!r || !r.run) { m.text = (r && r.error) || "The server did not start the request."; return done(); }

    if (e.type === "text") m.text = (m.text ? m.text + "\n\n" : "") + e.text;
    else if (e.type === "tool") m.steps.push(e.summary);
    else if (e.type === "approval") m.ask = { id: e.id, tool: e.tool, summary: e.summary, reason: e.reason || "" };
    else if (e.type === "answered") { if (m.ask && m.ask.id === e.id) m.ask = null; m.steps.push((e.allow ? "You allowed: " : "Refused: ") + e.summary); }
    else if (e.type === "result") { m.cost = e.cost_usd; m.secs = e.duration_ms != null ? e.duration_ms / 1000 : null; c.session = e.session || c.session; m.final = e.text || ""; if (!m.text && e.text) m.text = e.text; if (e.is_error && !m.text) m.text = "The request stopped: " + (e.subtype || "error") + "."; }
    else if (e.type === "error") m.text = (m.text ? m.text + "\n\n" : "") + "It stopped with an error: " + e.text;
    else if (e.type === "end") {
      es.close(); m.changed = e.changed || [];

// after every request: the item it was about and every item whose file Claude Code changed are marked changed until the sync
async function markWorked(id, changed, text, run) {

  for (const f of changed || []) { const k = String(f).replace(/^"|"$/g, "").replace(/\/$/, ""); if (byPath[k]) ids.add(byPath[k]); }
  const mark = { at: nowIso(), run: run || null, request: String(text || "").slice(0, 200) };
  for (const x of ids) { if (!NODES[x]) continue; try { await writeOV(x, { worked: mark }); } catch {} }
  rebuild(); renderTree(); renderSheet();
}
function agentHTML(m) {
  const steps = (m.steps || []).length ? `<details class="steps"${m.live ? " open" : ""}><summary>${m.steps.length} step${m.steps.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}</summary><ol>${m.steps.slice(-40).map(x => `<li>${esc(x)}</li>`).join("")}</ol></details>` : "";

}
/* ---------- Apply changes: one button at the top carries every change marked on the page into the files ---------- */
const plural = (n, w) => n + " " + w + (n === 1 ? "" : "s");

function confirmText(n) {

Then it rebuilds the tree and the page shows it. Each step shows in the chat of the top folder.` : "Claude Code is not set up on this server, so the changes cannot be applied from here.";

}

"Apply now" : "Save the request"}</button>`}<button class="btn" type="button" id="apply-cancel">Cancel</button>`;

  APPLY_MSG = null; APPLY_OPEN = !APPLY_OPEN;

}
async function applyNow() {
  const ids = Object.keys(CHANGED), n = ids.length; if (!n || !db) return;

    APPLY_RUN = true;

  const text = (`Apply changes: carry the ${plural(n, "change")} marked on the File Tree page into the files (sync the file tree), rebuild the tree and publish it here.\n\n${list}`).slice(0, 3800);
  let sent = null, why = CAN_SEND || "off";

    const go = $("#apply-go"); if (go) go.disabled = true;

    catch (e) { why = (e && e.code) || "upstream_error"; }
  }

function watchApply() {
  const w = applyWaiting();

  if (!APPLY_LOOKED) {   // the first look after loading: a request applied since this browser last saw one
    APPLY_LOOKED = true;

    return;
  }
  const was = APPLY_WAIT_ID && INPUTS.find(x => x.id === APPLY_WAIT_ID);
  if (!was) return;
  APPLY_WAIT_ID = null;
  if (was.status !== "processed") return;   // cancelled
  store.set("ftx-applied", was.id);
  if (SERVER) { APPLY_MSG = { text: "Your changes are applied. This is the new tree." }; reloadData(); return; }
  const v = DATA.data_version;
  fetch("file-tree.data.json", { cache: "no-cache" }).then(r => r.ok ? r.text() : null).then(raw => {
    let d = null; try { d = raw && JSON.parse(raw); } catch {}
    if (d && d.data_version > v) { applyData(raw); rebuild(); if (!NODES[selected]) selected = DATA.root; renderTree(); renderSheet(); APPLY_MSG = { text: "Your changes are applied. This is the new tree." }; }
    else APPLY_MSG = { text: "Claude applied your changes and published the new tree. Reload the page to see it.", reload: true };

  }).catch(() => { APPLY_MSG = { text: "Claude applied your changes and published the new tree. Reload the page to see it.", reload: true }; renderApply(); });
}
$("header.bar").addEventListener("click", ev => {
  const t = ev.target.closest("button"); if (!t) return;

});
boot();
})();

# file-tree-explorer.html

## Summary

The page itself: the tree of every folder and file with search and filters, and for each item its tabs: How it works, File, Example, Questions, extra tabs such as jobs, links, tests or key names, and Details. Every file shows its two metadata files as rows right under it, its How it works (`vision.index.md` for `vision.md`) and its Details (`vision.meta.json`, empty for now), and every folder shows its own first inside it; clicking one opens that tab, and the metadata switch above the tree hides or shows them. Folders start closed below the top levels; a first click on a closed folder opens it, and the search opens the folders on the way to each match. Every file and folder except the top has a Delete button next to its name: it opens a short form with an optional note for Claude, and the deletion runs the agent, which removes the item and cleans the project of it. A deleted item stays in the tree, struck through, until the next sync, and can be brought back. For now the page shows one status, "changed": a tag on whatever a request from the page touched (an edit, a note, an added or deleted item, a request in the box, a file Claude Code changed), listed on the Changed tab until the next sync. Its own File tab shows this source, the same file that is published, so the finished page is put in place before the data is built. It works in three places. On claude.ai it saves the owner's edits, notes, deletions and questions at once in its own store, and they reach the files at the next sync. An Apply changes button at the top, with the number of changed items, starts that sync: it sends Claude one comment on the page, and when Claude has applied the changes and published the new tree, the open page shows it. If no Claude is watching the page, the request is kept and the owner is asked to say "sync the file tree" in the project chat. On the owner's server it finds the server's service next to it, saves into the repository, writes edits straight into their files and sends requests, deletions and Apply changes to Claude Code. Served anywhere else it is view only and says so in its header. On the owner's server, the request box and the delete note box have a microphone button: it records up to 5 minutes, the server turns the recording into text, and the text is added to the box to check and send; on claude.ai the button is hidden.

## Keep in mind

- The page shows only the "changed" status for now; new statuses come only when the owner asks for them.

# The project IDE on your server

While the system is planned, everything runs from the planning folder `vision/`: the page is in `vision/explorer/`, the drafts and How it works files are in `vision/`, and Claude Code starts there. When the repository gets `apps/project-IDE/` and `agents/system/`, the paths in `server.config.json` move to them.

This folder runs the File Tree page on your own machine, with Claude Code behind its request box. It is the same page as on claude.ai. Here it reads the repository directly, saves your notes and edits into the repository, and sends what you type in the box at the bottom to Claude Code working in the project.

## What you need

- The repository cloned on the server, with a way to push.
- Python 3.10 or newer, Node, and Claude Code with its SDK: `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code` and `pip install claude-agent-sdk`.
- A way for Claude Code to sign in. Either put an API key in the keys file `.secrets/test/.env` as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...`, or sign Claude Code in once with `claude` in a terminal. The settings name the key; its value never leaves the keys file.
- For voice input, a Groq key in the same keys file as `GROQ_API_KEY=...` (free at console.groq.com). Without it the microphone button stays hidden.

## Start it

From the top of the repository:

```bash
python3 vision/server/server.py
```

It listens only on the machine itself, at `127.0.0.1:8765`. From your own computer, open a tunnel and then the page:

```bash
ssh -N -L 8765:127.0.0.1:8765 you@your-server
# then open http://127.0.0.1:8765/ in the browser
```

The header of the page says "on your server" when it found the service. Stop the service with Ctrl+C.

Never open the port to the internet or put the service behind a public address. Whoever can reach the page can make Claude Code change files and run commands. The server refuses to listen on any address but the machine's own.

## What happens when you use it

- **Notes, comments and edits** are saved at once as small JSON files in `vision/page-store/`, so they are in the repository and nothing waits on claude.ai. An edit to a file's text is also written straight into the file the page showed (a draft in `vision/`, or a real file in the repository), and an edit to How it works into the item's `.index.md`. An edit to a planned file nobody has written yet waits in the page store until the next sync.
- **A request in the box** runs as a Claude Code session started in `vision/`, the planning folder. From there Claude Code loads the planning copy of the system's agents and skills and its `CLAUDE.md` in `vision/.claude/`, so it works by the same rules as every other Claude on the project: it files your request, does the work, rebuilds the page and commits. The page shows each step while it works, then the answer with its cost and time, and reloads the tree if files changed. A follow-up in the same box continues the same conversation.
- **Delete** next to a file's or folder's name opens a short form with an optional note for Claude, such as what to move or keep first. Claude Code deletes the item and its How it works file straight away, then cleans the project of it: its place in the notes, links to it and mentions of it in other files. It keeps your note in mind, files the deletion and commits. The item stays on the page, struck through, until the next sync, and "Bring it back" undoes it the same way.
- **Voice input**: the microphone button next to the request box and the delete note box records you, up to 5 minutes, with a timer; press it again to stop. The server sends the recording to Groq and the text is added to the box, so you can check it before you send. If one Groq model hits its rate limit or fails, the next one in `server.config.json` is tried. The recording is not kept. The browser asks once for the microphone; open the page as `127.0.0.1` or `localhost`, since browsers allow the microphone only there or over HTTPS.
- **Steps that need your click** show up in the chat with Allow and Refuse buttons: pushing to GitHub, deleting anything other than the item you deleted, installing, network tools, and anything outside the repository. Nothing from the page can open the keys folder. A question nobody answers is refused after fifteen minutes.
- **Apply changes** at the top of the page shows how many items are marked changed. Pressing it starts one Claude Code run in the chat of the top folder: Claude Code brings everything waiting on the page into the files (the sync), rebuilds the page and commits, and the page loads the new tree.
- **The "changed" mark** shows on everything a request from the page touched: your edits and notes, new and deleted items, requests in the box, and every file Claude Code changed for you. The marks stay until the next sync.
- **Every request is logged** with its steps, answer, cost and time in `vision/logs/project-ide-agent/`.
- **"Sync the file tree"** typed in the box works here too: Claude Code folds what is waiting in the page store into the files, the same way it does for the page on claude.ai.

## Settings

`server.config.json`, next to this file:

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `host`, `port` | Where the service listens; only the machine's own address is accepted. |
| `page_dir`, `page`, `data` | The page and its data file. |
| `store_dir` | Where your notes, edits and messages are kept. |
| `write_through` | Write file and How it works edits straight into their files. |
| `secrets` | The keys file and the key names Claude Code gets; values stay in the keys file. |
| `claude.cwd` | Where Claude Code starts: the system folder. |
| `claude.model` | Which model; empty means Claude Code's default. |
| `claude.max_turns`, `claude.max_budget_usd` | Limits for one request. |
| `claude.allow` | Tools and commands Claude Code may use without asking. |
| `claude.ask_owner` | Words in a command that always wait for your click. |
| `claude.never` | Paths nothing may touch. |
| `log_dir` | Where each request is logged. |

## Files

- `server.py`: the web service: the page, the store, write-through and the request box.
- `claude_bridge.py`: runs each request as a Claude Code session and checks every step first.
- `voice.py`: turns a recording into text through Groq.
- `server.config.json`: the settings.

# voice.py

## Summary

Voice input for the page's request boxes. The page records the owner for up to 5 minutes and posts the recording to the server; this module sends it to Groq's speech-to-text service and returns the words, which the page adds to the box for the owner to check and send. It tries the Groq models listed in the server's settings in order: a model that answers with a rate limit is skipped until its wait is over, and an error moves on to the next one, so a busy model never stops the owner. The recording is not kept. The Groq key is read from the keys file by name and never reaches the page, the logs or Claude Code.

## Keep in mind

- When a Groq model is retired or a better free one appears, change the list in `server.config.json`; the first in the list is tried first.
- Never write the key's value anywhere but the keys file on the machine.

nodes.content:
# Agent OS: Knowledge base (v0.2)

This folder is the planning copy of the knowledge base. It holds everything we know about the system, split into layers so that one agent, the knowledge base agent [10.1.1.2] (D-033, D-034), can keep it right after every owner input or system change. In the repository (D-041) this guide and the records (`inputs/`, `decisions.md`, `changelog.md`, `file-tree.md`, the knowledge map) go to `apps/project-IDE/data/` [53.2], and the topic notes to `agents/system/docs/` [2]; the docs for people are in `agents/system/docs/` [2] too (D-047; they were in `.claude/docs/` [10.1.14]): the vision [2.2] first, then the README [2.1], and the rebuild prompt for AI [2.22] (D-048).

## Read order
<!-- k: id=readme-read-order applies=[2.1],[10.1.1.2] sources=D-033,in-20260930-1533 status=decided -->

1. `overview.md`: the whole system on one page.
2. `vision.md`: what the owner wants and why.
3. `architecture.md`: how the parts fit together.
4. `flows.md`: data flows and user flows, step by step.
5. `file-tree.md`: every folder and file, numbered [n], one section each.
6. `conventions.md`, `safety.md`, `data-schemas.md`, `glossary.md`.
7. `how-to/`, `common/`, `metrics.md`, `roadmap.md`.
8. History: `inputs/`, `decisions.md`, `changelog.md`. Indexes: `index/`.

## Layers
<!-- k: id=readme-layers applies=[2.1],[2],[10.1.1.2] sources=D-033,in-20260930-1533,in-20260930-1603 status=proposed -->

| Layer | Where | What it holds | Who writes it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inputs | `inputs/` | Every owner input, word for word, with its categories and what it changed | knowledge agent, on receipt |
| File docs | `file-tree.md` §2 | One section per file or folder: purpose, contents, writers and readers, open questions | knowledge agent |
| Topic docs | `overview.md`, `vision.md`, `architecture.md`, `flows.md`, `data-schemas.md`, `conventions.md`, `safety.md`, `glossary.md`, `metrics.md`, `roadmap.md`, `how-to/`, `common/` | Knowledge that is about more than one file: concepts, rules, formats, flows | knowledge agent |
| History | `decisions.md`, `changelog.md`, `inputs/index.json` | What was decided and changed, when, and from which input | knowledge agent |
| Map | `index/knowledge-map.json` | Which knowledge applies to which file or folder (many to many), built by `tools/build_map.py` | the script |
| How it works files | `[name].index.md`, one per file and folder, named without the file's extension, with an empty `[name].meta.json` beside it (a mirror in `vision/tree/` while we plan) | "How it works" for every file and folder, written bottom up from the layers above, plus a "Keep in mind" list (when dealing with this, do that) | knowledge agent, `file-index` skill |

One fact lives in one place. A file doc says what the file is and points to the topic doc for the shared rule; the topic doc says which files the rule applies to. Decisions are history, not a separate kind of knowledge: the rule a decision made lives in a topic doc, and the decision entry records when and why.

## Knowledge tags
<!-- k: id=readme-tags applies=[2.1],[2.18.8],[10.1.2.1],[14.1] sources=D-033 status=proposed -->

Every section of a topic doc that holds knowledge starts with a tag on the line after its heading:

```markdown
## Links file per agent
<!-- k: id=links-file applies=name:*.links.json,[14.1],[10.6] sources=in-20260930-1112,D-031 status=decided -->
```

- `id`: kebab-case, unique across the whole knowledge base.
- `applies`: comma-separated, no spaces. Each item is one of:
  - `[n]`: the object numbered n in `file-tree.md`.
  - `[n]/**`: the folder [n] as a whole. The knowledge is shown on [n] directly and on everything inside it as "from the folder above".
  - `path:<glob>`: every node whose path (without `agent-os/`) matches, e.g. `path:agents/**/configs/*.links.json`. `*` matches within one name, `**` across folders.
  - `name:<glob>`: every node whose name matches, e.g. `name:init.sh`, `name:*.workers.json`.
  - `none`: background knowledge that belongs to no single file (still shown on the root).
- `sources`: input ids (`in-YYYYMMDD-HHMM`), decision ids (`D-0xx`), or `derived` for our own synthesis.
- `status`: `decided` (owner said so), `proposed` (our idea, waiting for the owner), `open` (a question), `retired` (kept for history).

The section runs until the next heading of the same or a higher level, or the next tagged heading. Untagged headings (intros, changelogs) are not knowledge entries. `file-tree.md` object sections (`### [n] ...`) need no tag: each one is the file doc of the objects in its heading.

## Map and summaries
<!-- k: id=readme-map-summaries applies=[2.1],[2.18.8],[10.1.2.2],[14.1] sources=D-033,in-20260930-1533 status=proposed -->

`python3 tools/build_map.py` reads every doc here plus `file-tree.data.json` and writes `index/knowledge-map.json`:
- `entries`: every knowledge entry with its doc, heading, status, sources, hash and the nodes it resolves to.
- `nodes`: for every file and folder, its file doc, the entries that apply directly, the ones inherited from folders above, its children, and the `basis` hash its summary must match.
- `inputs`: every archived input and what it was processed into.
- `problems`: tags that do not resolve, duplicate ids, nodes with no knowledge at all.

Every file and folder has its How it works in its own Markdown file (D-039): `vision.index.md` next to `vision.md` (the file's name without its extension, D-057), `f/f.index.md` inside a folder `f/` (while we plan, in the mirror `vision/tree/agent-os/...`, through `tools/index_files.py`). The front matter carries `basis`, a hash of the node's file doc, the entries that apply to it directly and its children's How it works texts. When the basis in the map differs from the one stored in the file, the file is stale and gets rewritten, children first. A child that comes out unchanged stops the ripple there. `index/summaries.json` (D-033) is retired.

## The flow for every input or change
<!-- k: id=readme-flow applies=[2.1],[2.10],[10.1.1.2],[10.1.2.1] sources=D-033,in-20260930-1533,in-20260930-1841 status=decided -->

Every owner input (project chat, a thread, the File Tree page) and every change to the system goes through the `knowledge-intake` skill:

1. Store the input word for word in `inputs/` and add it to `inputs/index.json` with its categories. When the input is a question, store the answer with it: an answer is knowledge too.
2. Extract the knowledge in it: new facts, rules, formats, changes, questions answered, questions raised. For a question, extract from the answer as well; a question also shows where the docs were unclear, so the place that should have answered it gets clearer.
3. Place each piece: find the entries and file docs it touches through the map; update them in place, or add a tagged section to the right topic doc, or create a new doc when nothing fits (and add it to this README).
4. Ripple: every other entry and file doc that states the same thing is brought in line, so there are no two versions of one fact.
5. Record: a `decisions.md` entry when the owner decided something, a `changelog.md` line, and `processed_into` on the input.
6. Rebuild the map, then run `file-index` on every stale node, bottom up, up to the root.
7. Rebuild the explorer data and republish the page.

## Changelog
- v0.2 (2026-09-30): answers to the owner's questions are inputs too; every summary can carry an "Always keep in mind" list (in-20260930-1603, in-20260930-1841).
- v0.1 (2026-09-30): knowledge base created from `vision.md`, `overview.md`, `feature-map.md`, `file-tree.md` and the 41 owner inputs so far (D-033).

### [11.10] `system.workers.json` (D-029; was `workers.config.json`, D-007)
- **Purpose:** the system agent's own **jobs**: everything the system runs on a schedule or on demand, such as the data collectors shared by several domains [14.2], relinking and link checks, tests, index rebuilds and its sub-agent runs (SI [10.1.1.1]; the knowledge agent [10.1.1.2] as the `knowledge-sync` job, on changes under `agents/**` or `docs/inputs/**` and nightly, D-033). Every other agent has the same file for its own jobs in its `configs/` (domain [19.2.1], strategy [21.2.1], agent [27.4]), all in this format. The system sees each domain's file through [11.2] `subagents.link/` (D-030), and deeper ones one level down at a time.
- **All off for now (owner, page 2026-10-09, in-20261009-1040):** every system job has `enabled: false`; they stay in the file and run only once the owner turns them on.
- **What a job is (D-029):** either a plain **script** (`platform: none`) or an **AI run** on a coding-agent platform: the agent itself (`agent`: its main run, in its own folder), a `subagent`, a `skill`, a `workflow` or a slash `command`.
- **Job fields (proposed):** `id` (unique in the file) · `enabled` (turn off without deleting) · `purpose` · `type` (script | agent | subagent | skill | workflow | command) · `run` (the command for a script; the sub-agent, skill, workflow or command name otherwise) · `schedule` · `timezone` · `run_on` (local | cloud | desktop | github-actions) · `platform` (none | claude-code | cursor | codex) · `model` (`route` = take it from [11.11]) · `effort` · for AI runs: `prompt` (text, or `@path` to a prompt file), `workspace` (the folder it runs in; default the owner agent's folder), `allowed_tools`, `permission_mode`, `max_turns`, `max_cost_usd` · `secret_keys` (local runs only) · `inputs`, `outputs` · `on_change` (paths whose change starts the job; for the main run it cancels and restarts the current run) · `timeout`, `retries`, `concurrency` (skip | queue | restart) · `mode` (test | live; live needs owner approval) · `notify` (never | failure | always). The file's `defaults` fill in anything a job leaves out.
- **`schedule` (proposed, one short string):** `every 15m` / `every 6h` / `every 1d` · `cron 0 22 * * 1-5` · `once 2026-11-03 20:00` (runs one time, then shows as done) · `after [job-id]` (when that job succeeds) · `manual` (only from the UI or a command). Time zone from the job, else the file's `defaults`, else [11.1] `defaults.timezone`.
- **Where it runs (`run_on`, proposed):** `local` (default): headless on the machine that runs the scheduler [14.1], with the local files, links and test secrets. `cloud`: the platform's own cloud (Claude Code routines, Codex cloud, Cursor background agents): a fresh copy of the repo, no local files, no secrets; Claude Code routines run at most hourly. `desktop`: a Claude desktop scheduled task; it runs only while the app is open. `github-actions`: a scheduled workflow in the repo. The scheduler runs `local` jobs itself and registers the others on their platform.
- **How AI runs start (proposed):** `run-job` [14.1] builds the platform's headless command in the job's `workspace`: Claude Code `claude -p`, Cursor `cursor-agent -p`, Codex `codex exec`, with the job's model, prompt, tools, permission mode and turn limit. Adding a platform later means adding one command template to `run-job`.
- **Rules (proposed):** a `live` job needs owner approval and a live-allowed agent ([11.1] `modes`). `cloud`, `desktop` and `github-actions` jobs get no `secret_keys` and cannot act live. To pause a job, set `enabled: false`; never delete it to pause. Runtime state (last run, result, next run, fail count) is not written here: the scheduler keeps it in [16.1] `scheduler-state.json` and logs every run to the owner agent's `logs/jobs/[job-id]/`, so this file changes only when someone changes a job.
- **Writers / readers:** the owner (on the page: turn on/off, change when, where, platform, model); the owner agent's domain or SI sub-agents propose changes. Read by the scheduler and `run-job` [14.1], the index [2.18.2] and the UI.
- **Updated:** whenever a job is added, changed, rescheduled, turned off or removed.
- **Open:** Which machine runs the `local` scheduler: the owner's computer or a small always-on server? Should the scheduler create cloud routines by itself, or should the owner confirm each one?

### [11.13] `system.links.json` (D-031)
- **Purpose:** the system agent's own file links, and the **format every level uses**. Every agent has the same file in its `configs/`: domain [19.2.3], strategy [21.2.3], variant [27.3] (`[name]` as for the workers file: `system`, the domain name, or the agent name). For each link it says which file, from where, where it appears and why. The system's own list is short; most links sit in the agents at the lowest levels.
- **Fields (proposed):** `schema_version` · `agent` · `links[]`, one entry per link: `enabled` (off = relink removes the symlink but keeps the entry) · `to` (where the link appears, inside the agent's own `configs/`, `scripts/`, `logs/`, `data/`, `docs/`, `tests/` or `research/`; the name carries `.link`, e.g. `data/news-digest.link.md`) · `from` (the file it points at, see below) · `why` · `required` (true: a missing target is an error and the agent's main run does not start; false: a warning, and no link is made until the file exists) · `added_by` (create-agent, the agent itself, its SI sub-agent, owner) · `added` (date).
- **`from` (proposed):** a path under `agents/`, or a short form: `@system/…` (the system folder), `@domain/…` (the agent's own domain), `@strategy/…` (its own strategy, a level the prediction-market domain defines), `@[name]/…` (any domain or agent by its unique name, D-012, looked up in the registry [2.18.1], so the entry keeps working if that folder moves). Examples: `@system/data/subagents/news-digest/latest.md`, `@domain/data/markets-catalog/latest.json`, `@[other-domain]/data/[output]/latest.json` (another domain), `@[agent-name]/data/[output]/latest.json` (an agent anywhere, by its unique name).
- **Rules (proposed):** file links only (D-020): `from` is one real file; if it is itself a link, relink points at the real file behind it, so there are no chains. Never anything in `.secrets/` (D-023) or in any `.claude/` (D-030). `to` is always inside the agent's own folders, never inside `subagents.link/`. Links are relative symlinks and read-only for the agent. Child links (`subagents.link/`, D-030) are **not** listed here: relink builds them from the folder tree.
- **Writers / readers:** create-agent writes the first version; then the agent itself, its SI sub-agent and the owner (UI) edit it. `relink` and `check-links` [14.1] read it; the links index [16.1] and the UI show who links what.
- **Open:** Commit the symlinks themselves to git (a fresh clone works at once; the pre-commit hook keeps them in step), or git-ignore them and let relink rebuild them after every clone and pull? Proposed: commit them. May an agent link any file of another agent, or only files that agent lists as `outputs` of its jobs (a public contract)?

- **Purpose:** applications and projects, our own or from GitHub: the owner's IDE [53] `project-IDE/` (moved here, owner 2026-10-05 15:17, D-043) and the prediction-market domain's dashboard [45] `trading-ui/` (moved here, owner 2026-10-06, D-045; the domain's app, D-058). An outside app gets its own folder here when one is needed; the tree shows no example of one (owner, 2026-10-06).
- **Every app has its own docs (owner, 2026-10-06 22:06, D-055):** "apps folder also will contains apps and inside them docs". Each app's `docs/` holds `vision.md`, `README.md` and `rebuild-prompt.md` (for the IDE: [53.4]). Submodule or ignored clone for `repo/`, where the forks live on GitHub, how often to update (plan `2026-10-06-2206-apps-docs-clones-forks.md`).
